🔭 Ray Dalio — world power clusters/order

Dalio's "Big Cycle": empires rise/fall over ~250-yr arcs, scored by an 8-factor Power Index (education, innovation, competitiveness, output, trade share, military, financial-center strength, reserve-currency status). Reserve-currency status is the last thing to fall — historically the tell for late-cycle empires.

- His newer book (How Countries Go Broke, 2025) narrows to the debt mechanics specifically (Fact/source)
- As of Aug 2026 he's applying this to the US live: ~5.8%-of-GDP deficit, $36-38T debt, "3% solution" proposed (Fact/source, CNBC 2026-08-21)
- Expects multipolar re-ordering, not a clean US→China handoff (Inference)
- Note: raw drop was garbled voice transcription — flagged in the brief if this isn't the intended topic
